tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// thub bstan mkhan rin po che chos rnam rgyal bas brgal brtags kyi lan pha lam rdo rje'i mtshon cha

zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen dang brtse// nus pa'i 'dab brgya rnam rgyas pa// puṇḍa rī ka'i ge sar phreng*// legs gsung zil dngar spro der 'dud// de yi gsung zab mkha'i rnga chen// sgra dbyangs glog gi gar dang bcas// rtsod ngag gnam lcags 'bab pa'i zhugs// rtog ge'i spobs pas ma bzod tshe// gnam thig 'khyogs por btab pa yis// lcags kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs bcad pa'i// ngang tshul 'di dang 'di'o zhes// rim par gleng la khro mi 'tshal// sa skya'i paṇa chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs// padma dkar po spyan ras gzigs// bsnyon med sprul pa'i gar stabs la// bltas kyin dad pa'i dbang po mtho// chos rje sa paṇa da tsam du// 'tsho zhing gzhes na kho bo la'ang*// 'di ltar min pa'i mthong bkur zhig /'byung zhes pad dkar zhal las thos// de ni sa paṇa mkhas shing drang*// cig shos la la blun zhing 'khyog /rin chen rtog la ma mkhas pa'i// ded dpon 'ga' la khrel ba'i tshig /des na dkar brgyud bstan rjes su// dad pas 'brangs pa'i blun rgol 'ga'// yang dag lam la gzud phyir du// chos rjes dgag sgrub mdzad pa yin// de yis phyag rgya pa thams cad// skyon dang bcas par mi 'gro ste// glen par smad la spyang po rnams// khro gnyer sdud par mi rigs bzhin// 'on kyang de 'drar ma brtags pa'i// grub rigs som nyir gol ba rnams// blo gros brtags phyir pad dkar gyis// legs bshad khu ba gsar du zags// de yang shes bya rig pa'i gnas// rnam lnga mkhyen gzigs paṇḍi ta// grub pa chen po'i go 'phang la// bzhugs pa'i skyes chen dam pa yin// 'chad pa'i dbyangs kyis bstan pa spel// rtsod pa'i mtshon chas lugs ngan gtubs// rtsom pa'i bdud rtsis yid can kun// mchog chos grub pa'i dpal la bkod// bshad sgrub bstan dang bstan 'dzin gyi// skyes bu bkur sti rim gros mchod// mkha' lding mchod sdong zil gnon pa'i// gtsug lag khang chen bcu phrag tu// gser gyi lhun po gzugs gzhan lta'i// sras bcas rgyal ba'i sku mang bskrun// mthing shog ngos su gser zhun gyi// yig mtho'i glegs bam stong phrag bzhengs// mdo sngags bshad dang sgrub pa'i grwa// ji snyed 'tsho ba'i rkyen dang bcas// de snyed bsgrubs nas thub pa'i bstan// spel ba gzur gnas yongs la gsal// de lta'i ngo mtshar ri mo brgya// zhar ba'i mig gis ma mthong zhing*// snyan grags tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi 'gyur// lung khug 'on pa 'gas ma thos// rang tshul rang gis zhal 'ches pa// ngan na shākya seng ge dang*// sa skya'i lo tsā'ang der thal bas// tshig ngan mchod sprin der spos shig

/dam pa gong mas gtod pa'i srol// ming gi lhag mar gyur kyang rung*// che 'dod thab ka zin tsam la// snying por rloms dang 'di mi mtshungs// gan mdzod yi ge spar du bsgrubs// dbus gtsang mkhas pa yongs la spel// bstod dang smad sogs ku co'i dbyangs// kun la bsgrags pa'i lkog lab mtshar// de tshe chos grwa che de na// mkhan chen byams pa rab brtan dang*// bshes gnyen chen po chos 'od zer// mkhan slob tshul du bzhugs pas kyang*// gan mdzod 'di la gsang sngags shes// rtsod spong brtsams dus lhun po'i rtser// rnam rgyal khang bzang kyang med na// de yi dang po'i zhal drag sogs// khyad gzhi med pa'i khyad chos yin// chos pa 'bel gtam gleng ba la// khyim pa'i ngo 'dzin byed don ci// dus kyis ma bslad mkhas pa rnams// bstod phreng spel ba dag snang yin// mchan bu 'debs dus mi'i dbang po// rdo rje gdengs pa'i skabs yin der// 'jigs par rigs kyang kyur kyur gyis// tshig bcad dbyangs su gyer de ci// de phyir cha med rgyus gtam rnams// rgyus can mdun du smra 'di ko /gzur mi gnas pa'i ngang tshul kun// gzhan gyis go phyir yin lags grang*// brgal lan dngos po dang mthun pa// btab na rgol ba'i rjes 'brang khro// mdzes mtshon lan gyis dgos med pas// kho bo re zhig mi smra yi// mkhas dbang 'jam dpal grags pa sogs// 'ga' re'i lan thob bka' gnang yang*// nyung ja sgug pa'i thugs brel gyis// bstan pa yal bar bor zhes zer/ 25 /shes bya kun la dbang bsgyur ba'i// mkhas pas de lan ma thebs zhes// 'dzem med smra ba'i spyi brtol gyis// rang nyid dam pa min par bsgrubs// deng sang rgyal ba'i gan mdzod la// rgol 'dod gsar du skye ba 'di// da lta'i 'brug pa'i mkhos khyer la// rjes su dpag pa'i 'gro mtshams te// chu tshod nya pas lon tshe na// nya la sbar 'dzin byed pa'am// khyi nyams sprang pos len dus su// dbyug pa phred khur byed dang mtshungs// rab zhi'i nags su bsam gtan pa// zag med bde 'bras longs spyod dus// rtsod tshig lo 'bras btus shig ces// springs yig khwa ta'i skad kyis bskul// de tshe rjes thob sgyu ma'i 'phrul// dpyad gsum gyis dag rin po che'i// do shal gsar pa gzur gnas kyi// thong ka mdzes pa'i rgyan du sprul// de la glang stag yos 'brug lor// rnam dpyod spyan ras kyis btsas mthar// g.yo thabs sprin gyi 'gro 'ong gis// glegs bam bsring ba'i go skabs phye// gzu bos dpyad par gsol btab pas// phyogs gtam byin rlabs char 'bebs pa'i// bla ma bzang de'i thugs ka na// su bzhugs mkhyen spyan gsal bas gzigs// srid gsum rnam rgyal mgo rgyan la// dgyes dang dngos gzhir mi dgyes pa// bstod dang smad pa'i mjug ldog dpe// thugs kyi gting mtha' da bzod dpogs// rigs tshul mtshon cha sna tshogs rtse// lung mang sna tshogs kyis brdar bas// ngan smra sna tshogs tshar bcad tshe// sna tshogs las kun cis mi 'grub// rang skyon sbas nas gzhan gyi skyon// gleng ba sdigs na mdzub mo'i rtse// nang du khug dang mkhas pa'i rje// kun dkris lhad ngan 'dor ba gces// lhas byin dpral bar btab pa'i me// chos sbyin 'phongs kyis blangs pa'i zug

/ma bzod 'khun pa'i tshig tshogs rnams// grags 'dod dbugs dang ma 'dres sam// bstan bcos chab kyis bkrus kyang thugs// 'khyog po'i dri ma las ma grol// bsung zhim ga bur gyis byugs kyang*// sgog pas rang dri ga la dor// phyogs yo'i gnam thig btab kyang ci// rtsibs nyams gnam lcags 'khor lo ci// mun 'thum nyi ma'i snying pos ci// 'khyogs tshig drang por bos kyang ci// smra ba'i seng chen bsgyings pa'i zhal// lung rigs mche ba gzengs pa las// legs bshad gad rgyangs sgrogs re mod// phyogs lhung wa skad des ci bya// blun sgom dud 'gro'i rgyu sgrub thabs// khengs dregs dmyal ba sgrub pa'i thabs// spangs nas kun mkhyen legs grub pa'i// thabs tshul kho bos skal bas rnyed// dus kyi pho nyar 'jigs pa'i mi// rtsod tshig smra bar mi khom zhes// gsol gyin tshig sgum bsags pa'i skyes// dpal gyi ri bor springs pa'i lan// rang gzhung tshugs pa'i gzhu brdungs te// sgrub dang sun 'byin mda' bsnun pas// tshig tshogs spangs lcug 'khyil ba'i phub// che yang ci dgar 'bigs la gzigs// 'on te mkhas pa'i mkhyen rab dang*// lhan cig gnas pa'i gzu lum gdon// mi bsrun pa des ci byar yod// sras bcas rgyal bas dpang mdzod cig /zhes bya ba ni pha lam rdo rje'i mtshon cha las gleng gzhi gleng bslang gi sarga ste dang po'o/// / de phan rkyen gyi nyid sgra dang*// gzhi la sbyar ba'i rang sems gnyis// nus mtshungs lung des ma phan na// sdeb sbyor bshad pa 'dir mi khom// kun gzhi dang ni kun gzhi yi// rnam par shes pa nor ba ste// kun gzhi las ni rnam shes skye// zhes gsungs pa dang 'gal phyir ro// gzhi dus phyag chen bzhed mi bzhed// gang dgyes mdzod la gzhi rgyud de/ skabs 'dir tshig rkang gcig chad dam snyam// gsungs phyir gshis la sbyor dgos so// 'di skabs brjod par bya ba ni// mang por gsungs te mang gin lod// a pha lags kyi zhal shul de// rang gi nang du gtsang ba tsam// 'jig rten tha snyad 'gog bzhed na// ja za chang za thug pa za// zan 'thung sha 'thung snum khur 'thung*// gsungs la smyon pa'i lad mo mdzod// khams kyi zas sogs gzugs can rgyan// yin phyir 'di la phan gnod med// gzhan du reg bya ji ltar mid// zas dang za la rnam dbye bdog

/'thung ba'i zlas phye za ba dang*// som za dogs za rnam rtog za// the tshom za sogs skad dod gnyis// tha dad yod do rdza ma gcog /khrel nas rgod pa'i sgra bsgrags na// nus pa yod mod glen pa bzhin// don med rgod mthar khrel ba la// bstod pa rkun rgyab rdzun gnon yin// rtsod spong mkhan po'i thugs gtad mtshams// de lta min kyang de sgrub phyir// skyogs kyin lham dpe zhwar 'gebs pa// skyur rjes skam gnon ngo mar go /rigs par smra la rtog ge pa// zer na shāka thub kyang der thal// sa paṇa rtog ge par bzhed pa// grags pa'i spyan sngar khengs skyungs yin// rtog ge pa yi gtsug nor zhes// bshad pa'i rtags kyis de de ru// mi 'grub dper na 'jig rten gyi// gtsug nor thub pa'ang de min bzhin// skabs dang ma 'brel e ma hoḥ 'gog phyir grong gseb tshes bcu zhes// rnam bcad smras la ma brtags pa'i// lung 'dren byed pa hob spyod yin// phyag rgya che las ma g.yos bzhin// rigs smra'i rtog ges rtog ge'i lugs// smra la skyon med ci gsungs mtshang*// brlag ces smra ba phyogs lab yin// ri yi bu chung 'gro shes pas// ri bo'i ngogs la rgyu zhing 'dug /thang la 'khyams pa'i bu chung phal// co 'dri'i slad du khyed cag bzhed// skabs min smyon pa'i bla col bzhin// a la la hos ci zhig btub// a la la dang e ma hoḥ spyir btang 'gog pa'i dpe yod dam// des na phyogs snga ma longs par// lung mang 'dren pa'i ngal bas ci// mngon rtogs yan lag drug bsgom mkhan// btsun skam ma lags btsun rlon yin// bye mdo ltar gsungs grub pa'i mtha'// de ngor bden bden rtag rtag yin// dgongs te gsungs dang ji bzhin sgra// gcig na mtha' drug ga la tshang*// dgongs pa bzhi dang ldem dgongs bzhir// rdzun zhes smra ba'ang ming tsam yin// thub pas rdzun ma gsungs pas ljags// ring pos zhal gyi dkyil 'khor khebs// thos bsam sgom nas brtul zhugs spyod// gsung rgyu red kyang yi ger nor// bar tshig mi mngon dpe bzang po// 'di 'dra bkab nas ci zhig mdzad// chos gzugs don dang ma ldan chos// byed mkhan mang nyung gar yang bdog

/snying po'i don bsgoms rtogs ldan tsho// nyid kyis gzigs sar 'ong don med// 'dod yon don gnyer zang zing nor// zhe la brnags pa'i kun tu rgyur// gshe ba de yang rnyed bkur ba// 'dris 'khren slad kyis ma bslad dam// smin ru 'degs pa'i zog po 'ga'// zas kyis brid nas de 'gug thabs// g.yo sgyu lags mod slong phor du// pham phabs byin la myur du skrod// rnal 'byor cha lugs nges med rnams// dad ldan skye bos mchod pa la// sdang bar ci rigs mi 'thad na// lung rigs mtshon chas tshar gcod rigs// rang 'dod ma 'khris gzhan don du// gtam nor phyogs kyis cha 'dzin tshul// gang 'dul snang cha med pa dang*// kha spu breg sogs mang pos bstan// mtha' drug dang ni bshad tshul bzhis// gang gang 'dul 'os de la de// ston shes bla ma mkhas pa ste// nges don gcig pus kun mi thul// dbang po mchog la de bzhin nyid// ston pa nges pa'i don yin kyang*// dbang brtul rna bar de ldug pa// dgongs min yin te sgron gsal las// dbang po dman pa'i sems can rnams// rtogs phyir shin tu gsal ba yi// de nyid gsal bar ston pa ni// dgongs min ces par gsungs phyir ro// des na 'dren pa rnam gsum gyis// gdul bya gang la nges pa'i don// smar gcig zong cig ston pa ni// thabs la mi mkhas u tshugs yin// kun la nges don chos 'doms kyang*// la la'i bdud rtsi la la'i dug /yin phyir gang la gang sman pa'i// chos ston dgos pa spyod 'jug las// dman la zab dang rgya chen dang*// skyes pa med la bud med min// zhes sogs lung la ma rgol bar// mkhas pas mkhas pa'i bya ba mdzod// stong pa ma yin mi stong min// zhes sogs 'khor gsum dag pa'i ngang*// rang bzhin shes par la bzla ba// phyag rgya pa rnams bzhed lags kyang*// stong nyid kho na bsgom zhes dang*// brtag dpyad med pa'i blun po zhes// bka' bkyon kho na bris 'dug ste// phyogs snga med pa'i phyogs su log

/nyi ma'i 'od zer ming snyan kyang*// pad dkar 'dab brgya 'grol ma nus// de la snying rjes de'i zegs ma// cung zad mchan bur btab pa lags// byang 'brog la smras rtsed mo'i tshig /lho 'brog thugs kyi zug rngur smin// bya la sog mda' 'phangs pa'i zug /rta la don med ci'i phyir langs// stong gsum khyab pa'i lha'i rnga sgra// 'dod na byams pa'i lung dang 'gal// 'gal ba rnam drug snyan dngags kyi// skyon yin de ni sel dgos lags// rgyu mtshan daṇḍi'i tshig rgyan du// thos bcas gsungs pa lung nyid de// snyan ngag mkhan po bag med las// de der 'jig rten grags pa bzhin// min par gal te rab zhugs na// 'di ni yul sogs 'gal zhes brjod// ces gsungs de yi dmigs bsal kyang*// 'di la mi 'grig phyir na spangs// 'ud gog che tshad 'phral byung rgyan// yin na ri bong rwa phreng gis// stong gsum brgyan zhing nam mkha' yi// padmo'i bcud kyang gzhibs shes smros// de phyir 'jig rten mtshams brgal ba'i// rgyan gyi dam pa gzhung bzhin sbyor// sngon med phul byung thub bstan gyi// bla brang chen mor gsar 'khrungs yin// thag rul sne la 'breng gsar 'ga'// mthud nas nam mkha'i mtha' 'chings zhes// smra ba gtsang po'i lho nas byung*// bros rnams ded dus 'khun pa'i sgra// legs bshad bza' btung bsod pa yis// tshims rnams kha dang tshwa skyur gyi// ro ldan za la ci ste sred// dri tsam gyis kyang dang kha 'gegs// klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i phyogs skyor gyis// brel bas gsol dang 'byed na yang*// sprul skus g.yos pa'i sbang zan 'di// gzigs ma thag tu 'gag par nges// blo gsal yi ga 'byed nus pa'i// sman mchog mchis na stsol zhig ces// nan yig zhu ngor sbran pa'i lan// ha ha he he rnam brgyad bzhed// zhes bya ba ni pha lam rdo rje'i mtshon cha las bzhad bgad nyams ldan gyi sarga ste gnyis pa'o/// /

slob dpon mchog gis skal bzang 'ga'// tshegs chung byin rlabs kyis smin par// mdzad pa'i srol bzang rma med 'di// skyong phyir byin rlabs dbang du byed// slob ma kun la smin byed dbang*// 'gros gcig kho nar bskur dgos pa'i// sgrub byed des ni rdo rje'i theg /thabs mang gsung ba'ang dngos su bkag /thugs rje'i bdag nyid drin can gyis// sogs kyis go don slob dpon la// sbyor bar pha rgan dam pas gsungs// de ni dkar brgyud rnams kyang bzhed// 'phags yul mkhas grub dam pa'i gsung*// bod ban blun pos 'gog pa 'di// snyigs ma lnga bdo'i lang tsho la// longs su spyod pa'i rtags su 'khums// rkun rgyab rdzun gyis cher mnan te// lung don 'khyog por 'grel mkhas pa// de 'dra de 'dra mthong thos tshe// lnga brgya tha ma'i rang mtshang rig /bstan pa yongs rdzogs bshes gnyen du// bstod kyang rdza bcag rol mo mkhan// sgom chen mnyam nyid klong yangs las// rnam dag tshig don thogs med babs// rgyas 'grel dri med 'od las 'dir// las dang po dang rnal 'byor dang*// grub dang thams cad mkhyen pa ces// rnam bzhir gsungs pa'i dang po ni// tshogs sbyor pa la dngos su bshad// gzhan gsum mthong sgom mi slob par// bzhag cing de bzhin nā ro pas// dbang gi bya ba mdor bsdus su// dang po'i las can rnams dga' ba'i// dkyil 'khor cho ga bshad par bya// zhes gsungs de la de'i dngos slob// pradzñārakṣi ta dang gzhan// ma na ka ni shrīs kyang*// dang po'i las tshogs sbyor bar bshad// la sogs ma gzigs bzhin du 'dir// gang na'ang mi snang zhes gsungs pa'i// thag chod gtam de sngas pa tsam// yang na lo bzhir sna tshogs dper// gzigs pas blo gros 'khrugs sam ci// ha le ho le de 'dra zer// 'di la rgyud dang sems 'grel gyi// lung mang yod kyang yi ger 'dzems// mtha' yas chos kun ma gzigs pa// de srid brlings por smra ba mdzes// brtan thob rnal 'byor spyod pa la// rgyu tshe lus ngag bza' btung sogs// nges pa med pa'i sgrub byed du// khur gyi lung 'dren mdzad pa de// nges med bsgrubs la nges can lung*// drangs pa e 'gro gzigs 'tshal te// phyag rgya bcings spangs nges pa dang*// las mi bya bar nges pa dang*// phyag mi bya bar nges pa sogs// nges pa mang po'i nges med mtshar// gnyis med ye shes sems ldan pas// mi bya ba ni ci yang med// zhes pa'i lung dang dngos su 'gal// brtan pa thob pas bris bsgrub sogs// byas na dngos grub 'phrog bden na// brtan pa thob pa'i dam bca' nyams// brtan ma thob pas spangs blangs bya// thob nas dam tshig sdom las grol// 'di ltas rgyud don 'grel shes na// 'gal ba'i phung po g.yang sar 'khyur// dbang ma bskur la bla ma yi// don thob med par gsungs ltar 'dir// dpe yi ye shes sogs la ming*// yang dag btags kyang yang dag min// gong ma thob nas 'og ma'i lam// spong ngo zer mkhan kho bo min// gnad ma zin pa'i ca co yis// bslus kyang nyid rang bslus par zad// bla ma'i dus thabs bstan pa'i gtso// khyab gdal chen po'i mos gus yin// de dang rang gi legs byas gnyis// 'dzom na 'phral du grol ba la// dgongs nas bla chen sa skya pas// legs par gsungs kyang nyes par 'grel// pha rabs gcod pa'i bu 'ga' zhig

/der yang bzhugs pa da bzod go /mtshan ldan dpon slob mjal tsam gyis// grol ba thob pa 'gro ba'i lung*// drangs pa de kun sa skya pa// chen po'i gsung la gzas par zad// klu sgrub rgya mtshor smras la khyed// khro ba'ang rigs pa min na ko /sa chen gsung zab bstod pa la// 'khu ba'i sa skya pa de su// rong ston lha dgas rdzogs chen gyi// che ba brjod pa bden mod kyi// mi la rdzogs chen gyis 'dul ba'i// snod min phyir na des ma grol// pi pi ling gi sman bzang yang*// tshad nad can la dug bzhin du// rdzogs chen zab kyang thos pa dgar// ma phan dkar brgyud bsten ces grags// des na rang rang skal ba dang*// 'tshams pa'i chos tshul las 'phros rnyed// de grol ga bur bzang po yis// tshad pa'i nad bu gzhil la ltos// yang dag lam bzang bdud rtsi yis// thugs rgyud bsher la rlon pa dang*// cig shos de la skam po'i ming*// btags pa'i skam por khyed spro'am// mi bskyod chu dbang lta bus kyang*// dri ma bzhi dag nus pa bzhi// smin par nus na de ka dbang*// yin no thog mar de sgrubs shig /mchog dbang sngon du byis dbang bdun// bskur bar bshad pa'i rgyud lung rnams// spyir btang rim par 'jug tshul gyi// dmigs bsal srid mtha' 'gegs pa min// ces sogs sngar yang smras lan du// bzlos skyor mang yang snying po ci// dbang bdun sngon du ma song la'ang*// gong ma'i dbang tsam la brten nas// yan lag drug gi khrid 'debs srol// mkhas pa snga ma mang pos mdzad// des na dus 'khor shes pa la// mi shes pa tshos co ma 'dri// mchog dbang thob la rtsa ltung rnams// byung na slar yang byis pa'i dbang*// len par smra ba rdzun tshig gam// yang na dus 'khor gsar 'gyur yin// 'on kyang bum gsang la gnas par// rtsa ltung 'byung ba'i phyir bcos su// slar yang dbang bdun len na de// mchog dbang rjes su byis dbang bdun// bskur bar song bas snga phyi log

/rtsa ltung bcu bzhi'i dogs spong sogs// sngar bshad de la gzigs dang des// rgya mdud lhod po grol te mchis// rim par 'jug pa'i spyir btang lung*// mang po drangs nas dmigs bsal rnams// 'gog pa khyed cag bzhed des na// mkhas pa'i zhal bzhes mtho yang dma'// thag rul sne la 'breng rul gcig /btags pa'i zhags rul chung ngu 'dis// mkhas rul chen po bcings pa'i gtam// grwa rul mang pos phyogs brgyar bsgrags// go ram bstan pa'i nyi ma yis// phye ba thub bstan padmo'i tshal// chos bzhin skyongs shes mkhas pa ste// dgos med ngan rgyab skyor des ci// zhes bya ba ni pha lam rdo rje'i mtshon cha las ye shes grub pa'i lung don sogs la dpyad pa'i sarga ste gsum pa'o/// / dbang ma thob pa 'tshang rgya ba// rdo rje theg par med pa'i lung*// mang du drangs te bdag cag kyang*// nges par 'dod la klan ka ci// dbang ma bskur kyang thob pa yi// gang zag srid mtha' 'gog pa'i tshul// lung de rnams la med pa'i phyir// tshig rtsa mnan pa'i gtam gleng 'tshal// dbang bskur sngon du dkyil 'khor che// mthong ba dgos pa'ang bden mod kyi// ma bskur bar thob skal bzang des// don dam dkyil 'khor dngos su mthong*// rdo rje ye shes 'bab de yis// dkyil 'khor der mthong dbang der thob// sgro 'dogs thams cad der chod pas// phyin chad lam gzhan sbyangs dgos med// 'jug dang dbang sogs cho ga bzhin// bskur na thob la ma bskur na// mi thob pa yi gang zag la// rim pa ji bzhin bya bar gsungs// rdo rje ye shes dbang bskur de// smin zin rtogs pa'i bogs dbyung phyir// slad kyis bskur zhes klu sgrub kyis// rtsod spong dag las byung min nam// de ni khyed bzhed ltar na dbang*// go rim 'chol par 'gro ste der// gsum pa med par bzhi pa ru// mchongs pa dngos su grub la gzigs// de lta mod kyis dbang de ni// rnal 'byor pa la bskur bas na// rnal 'byor pa la 'chol pa'i dbang*// bskur bar lhun gyis de ru grub// drod thob rnal 'byor pa la dbang*// bskur mkhan rdo rje slob dpon de// blo dang mi ldan pa ru yang*// khong gis bsgrub ste snying 'grel lung*// rdo rje slob dpon blo ldan gyis// dbang la 'chol pa'i skyon spangs la// go rim bzhin du bskur zhes drangs// 'chol par bskur de blo ldan min// 'bru don ma myang tshig gi rtsa// ma zin bzhin du phyogs skyor gyi// thugs 'dod zhal du 'tshang tsa na// rdzob rtags de 'dra 'byung shas che// rtsa ltung bcu bzhi'i nang na yang*// dbang gong kho na'i mi mthun phyogs// 'ga' yod de la ma brtags par// gya tshom smra ba mdzes ma yin// khyad par byis 'jug dbang bdun po// bum dbang yin zhes smra bas so// dus 'khor brda' dang tha snyad kun// don med ston pa'i bla mar khugs// rgya gar grub thob rdzun ham pa// mdzad dam 'on te min kyang 'dra// gdul bya'i khams dang rjes mthun pa'i// dbang bskur rnam dbye mang zhig mdzad// gong 'og kun tu rtogs ldan dang*// 'khrul pa zhig rnams thabs du mas// smod tshig me char 'bebs pa 'di// dam pa'i chos dang e mthun soms// dus kyi dbang gis phyogs gar yang*// chos bzhin sgrub pa nyung ba dang*// chos 'gal spyad pa mang ba ni// mngon sum pa la su zhig bsnyon// rang phyogs shugs 'gro'i ba rgan kyang*// seng ger bstod cing gzhan phyogs kyi// seṅge'ang bong bur smad pa de// thugs ma tshad kyi mtshon dpe yin// mu stegs can la'ang smad byas na// rnam par snang mdzad ring ba'i rgyu// gsungs na mchog gsum 'bangs gyur rnams// snying nas smod la smos ci dgos// gang zag rgyud tshod brtags dka' bas// kun la dag snang sbyong ba zab// dag snang med pa'i mkhas pa phal// a khu ston pa'i pha tshan yin// gal te de pa'i lta spyod rnams// mi 'thad na ni dngos su de// lung rigs drag pos tshar chod la// yang dag lam la khyed kyis tshud// bdag ni rtogs par mi ldan zhes// sgrogs mkhan mang zhing don la'ang gnas// 'khrul pa ma zhig grong la 'khyams// 'du long che sar rgyug mkhan min// rta nag phyogs la 'grim ma myong*// phrin las kha ru 'tshangs pa'ang med// nyid thugs snyung ba'i las ma byas// blun bsgom ma yin zog ma btsongs// de lta na'ang bdag la 'dir// yang yang smad la dgos pa ci// tshig pa pha la zos pa yis// brdung brtags bu la btang ba 'khrul// rang gi bla ma'i bzhed gzhung 'dzugs// de la rtsod spong gtam tshogs 'god// chos dang gang zag la mos pa// 'di gsum kho bo'i g.yar dam lags// dbang bzhi'i grangs dang go rim rnams// spyir btang dmigs bsal don thob sogs// mtha' dpyod smra ba'i sgo chen po// sngar nas phye ba der zhugs shig

/rgyas par ngam ring mkhan chen la// lan du gsol ba de yongs rdzogs// khams pa drung nas la phul yod// gsung res mchis na de las bzhes// snying po'i don dam yang dag mtha'// bsam brjod yul las ngang bskal phyir// thos bsam 'jig rten bsgom pa yis// rtogs pa min te byams mgon gyis// phra phyir thos pa'i yul ma yin// don dam yin phyir bsam pa'i min// chos nyid zab phyir 'jig rten pa'i// bsgom pa la sogs yul min gsungs// de ni dpal ldan a ti shas// mngon sum dang ni rjes su dpag /gnyis pos stong nyid rtogs so zhes// tshur rol mthong ba'i rmongs pa smra// mu stegs nyan thos rnams kyis kyang*// pa ni// mu stegs rtsod pa bzlog pa'i phyir// mkhas pa rnams kyis byas pa yin// lung las kyang ni gsal po ru// rtog bcas rtog pa med pa yis// shes pa gnyis kyis mi rtogs te// zhes dang bde ba'i rdo rjes kyang*// gcig dang du bral gtan tshig rnams// 'od gsal rtogs la dgos pa med// bde chen der snang mngon sum la// lung dang rjes dpag gzhal mi dgos// zhes dang rigs ldan grags pa yis// phung po rnam dpyad stong pa nyid// chu shing bzhin du snying po med// rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i// stong nyid de ltar 'gyur ma yin// zhes gsungs gzhan yang do ha sogs// grub brnyes gzhung lugs du ma dang*// tshad ma mdo sogs mkhas pa'i gzhung*// nges don ston pa'i mdo sde dang*// rgyud sde'i gsang tshig du ma las// shin tu mthun par gsungs phyir ro// 'o na gang gis rtogs she na// mgon po byams pas rgyud bla mar// rang byung rnams kyi don dam ni// dad pa kho nas rtogs bya yin// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba// mig med pas ni mthong ba med// ces dang rgyud kyi rgyal po las// gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus thabs bstan pa dang*// rang gi bsod nams las shes bya// 'di ni byin rlabs rim pa'i phyir// kun mkhyen ye shes de lta bu// zhes sogs gsungs phyir legs byas las// byung ba'i mos gus chen po yis// bskul bas byin rlabs kho nas so// lung rigs kyis dpyad stong pa nyid// don spyi yin gyi mngon sum min// de ni dug can lta bu ste// thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu dngos min// klu sgrub yab sras rtog ge pa'i// gral du bkod nas ci zhig bsgrub// zab mo lta ba'i srol 'byed la// skur 'debs de las che ba gang*// bzad rings rig pa'i seng ge sogs// rgol ba yin gyi dpang po min// nangs kyi mtha' la rtsod rgyal tshe// 'khor tshogs bros nas shags ma phye// khams pa drung nas rtsod yig tu// de dus dpang po med ces gsungs// mkhan slob sku yon su che rung*// cung zad slob dpon drang bar go

/tshar bcad pa dang tshar bcad kyi// gnas la rnam dpyad ma zhugs pa'i// smra ba ngan des mkhas pa bzang*// chud zos btang ste 'phongs pa tsam// zhes bya ba ni pha lam rdo rje rdo rje'i mtshon cha las dbang sogs sna tshogs pa'i don la dpyad pa'i sarga ste bzhi pa'o/// / gzhan gyi gdams ngag bka' gdams la// zer ba mi 'thad na yang de// rab dbye'i dgongs 'grel 'ga' las byung*// gral dang bstun na 'grig 'grig 'dra// phyag chen go cha gnyis ma de// jo bos rnal 'byor pa la gnang*// de las rim brgyud phag gru pas// zin bris btab nas rgya cher spel// bka' gdam man ngag mtha' dag pa// pu to pa la med pas na// de gsungs gtan tshigs phyogs re yis// yod pa med par bsgrub mi 'tshal// bka' gdams lam gyi rim pa dang*// dkar brgyud phyag rgya chen po'i rgyun// dwags po'i thugs mtshor 'dres pa la// bka' phyag chu bo gnyis 'dres zer// skabs de'i phyag rgya chen po yang*// nā ro'i lugs kyi phyag chen te// dwags po yab sras bzhed gzhung la// gzu bo'i blo yis brtags pas shes// phag grus sa skyar lam 'bras zhus// thun mong nyams myong bzang po 'khrungs// dpe mdzod ma sogs yi ge mdzad// slob ma 'ga' la bshad pa'ang bden// de yis lam 'bras bsgom bzhin par// 'grub na mkhas grub khyung pos kyang*// bon dang rdzogs chen nyan bshad pas// de dag bsgom bzhin par yang mtshungs// lam 'bras zab kyang phag gru la// thun mong nyams las skyer ma 'dod// dwags po'i drin las 'phags pa'i lam// 'khrungs pa rang rang las 'phros yin// bsil sman tshad par phan pa dang*// drod sman grang bar phan pa gnyis// sman gyi bzang ngan ma yin kyang*// nad pa'i khams la 'jug ldog bzhin// sngar gyi lam gyi grul ma btub// zer ba thugs su ma shong bar// ku co dbyangs su gyer ba de// mkhas pas blun gtam glengs pa yin// nyams myong de yis 'phags lam gyi// go ma chod par slar 'khrungs la// bsam nas de yi grul ma btub// smras la skyon dris ga la reg

/dper na tshad ma'i thal phreng gis// sgom chen pa la grul mi btub// rtags des thal phreng ngan pa ru// sus sgrub pa de glen pa yin// dwags po mjal nas sa thob ces// smras pas phag mo gru pa la// skur pa btab par 'gyur ro zhes// gsungs pa gsol ja bzang ba'i nyams// rgyu mtshan de dag rnams kyi phyir// bdag ni lam 'bras la sogs pa'i// zab chos nyams su ma longs kyang*// kun tu mi spongs skur mi 'debs// chos la smod pas sdom pa gnyis// 'jig na phyag rgya chen po dang*// de 'dzin dkar brgyud la smod mkhan// rnams kyis thugs bsam btang re ran// khyad chos bsre 'pho zhes bya ba// rgyud dang 'brel ba'i thabs lam ste// lam srol kun gyi lus rdzogs pa'i// man ngag chen po zhig gi ming*// phyag chen chos drug rim pa lnga// sbyor drug phyag rgya bzhi la sogs// byin rlabs dang 'brel snyan brgyud kyi// lam skor bye brag so so'i ming*// de lta'i rnam dbye ma nges pas// gzhan la smra ba spyi brtol te// khri mthor 'gying la mi mdzes pas// bag yod ran par gsungs 'tshal lo// phyag chen lam 'bras zhi byed sogs// bsres pa'i chos drug sgom pa po// dkar brgyud gtsang ma'i khrod na med// de la klan ka byar ci yod// glegs bam gcig tu chos mang po// bsdus pa ri chos skor gsum ste// de lugs dkar brgyud gtsang min pas// gzhan ni med ces tshig dbus bton// dper na thub bstan pa'i khrod na// bya gshong rjes su 'jug mkhan ni// gzhan med da lta'i mkhan slob gnyis// yin nam zhes pa lta bus mtshon// des na 'gal ba med pa la// 'gal ba brjod pa'i thal 'gyur gyi// nus pas ri bong rar 'gran pas// ba lu'i rdo khog bcag ces thos// mi la yan dang man sogs kyi// smra ba phal cher don med de// phyag chen 'gog pa ma go bar// chos drug gtam des ci zhig bya// 'jam dbyangs dgongs zab ji bzhin du// go ba su zhes tshol ba'i slad// 'di yi mtha' dpyod rta nag la// bzhon nas gtsang po brgal te bzhud// mang pos bkag kyang ma khegs pa'i// phyag rgya chen po'i lugs srol mchog

/skyong mkhas dbyar gyis chu bo bzhin// grangs med brdol la su zhig bsnyon// phyogs snga'i skya rengs ma btang bar// dgag pa'i nyi ma kha shor zhig /bya rgod gshongs nas sngar shar mod// da bzod rta nag phyogs su 'phos// legs par bshad la bden nam snyam// skyes pa log shes ma yin pas// lan gyi spros pa ma mdzad na// mkhas pa'i rang tshugs mi nyams kyang*// grags pa 'dod pas grags min gyi// rnga chen bskul ba'i rol mo de// rang gi de nyid rang nyid kyis// sgrogs pa'i las la 'bad pa bzhin// kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge la// bdag cag dad kyang skabs 'dir gsung*// khas len mi 'os de yis phyir// 'byor mngon sum du// byas la bden pa mthong ba dang*// rang bzhin 'od gsal rtogs pa dang*// don dam mngon du gyur pa zer// 'on kyang 'od gsal de las slar// sgyu mar ldang rgyu'i shes sgrib de// sbyangs phyir bsam gtan rnam gnyis kyis// ldang 'jug dgos ring slob zung 'jug /de mthar son pas rang gzhan gyi// don gnyis grub pa mi slob pa'i// zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang dbang gang*// yin par grub mchog rnams kyis gsungs// zung 'brel tsam dang zung 'jug gi /rnam spyi ma shar bzhin du 'dir// mang du smras pa rdzob rtags kyi// phreng ba ring por brgyus pa yin// rdor phreng lung don sgyu ma'i sogs rtog ge pas// zab don gtam du glengs pa'i skyon// rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog de nyid// ye nas ma bcos lhun gyis grub// de nyid rang byung bcom ldan te// rgyu rkyen la ltos rang byung min// ming du btags la rgyu mtshan ni// bshad du yod med sna tshogs mod// btags la dgos pa med ces pa// mkhas pas gsung bar mi rigs dper// rang bzhin gdags pa ma mdzad na// 'jig rten thams cad rmongs pa 'gyur// de bas rmongs pa bsal ba'i phyir// mgon pos ming du btags zhes gsungs// theg chen lam la phyogs re ba// med par zung 'jug 'ba' zhig na// phyogs re'i thabs kyis mi grol zhes// phyogs re yod pa gsungs de ci// zhes bya ba ni pha lam rdo rje'i mtshon cha las phag gru'i lo rgyus sogs la dpyad pa'i sarga ste lnga pa'o/// /

phyag rgya bzhi yi go rim thad// se'u bcu pa'i ngag bzhin du// 'brel med snang ba yi ge pas// nor bar gzhan du ga la srid// 'on kyang nā ro mai tri yis// bshad dang rab dbyer gsungs go rim// ma gcig pa la brtsad pa ste// de las don 'bras gzhan yang smin// rgyud sde rnams las phyag rgya bzhi'i// rim pa mi 'dra mang bshad pas// rab dbye'i go rim ma dag ces// smyon pa min pa su zhig smra// de la kun mkhyen padma dkar// spobs pa gtug ces smra ba de// rang nyid dam pa min no zhes// sgo yig rang gis btab pa yin// go rim tsam la rtsod pa de// smra ba'i 'phongs pa yin nam ka'i// dbang bzhi'i go rim bsgrub pa yang*// smra bas 'phongs pa e yin soms// sa skya gong ma'i gsung nor zhes// bsgrub pa'i sa skya pa khag gis// grub thob min pa'i grub rdzun dang*// mnyam du dmyal bar bang 'gran byas// rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa nyid// snang ba dang bcas sgyu ma'i ming*// 'gyur med bde bas 'khyud de la// zung 'jug dus kyi 'khor lo bzhed// nye rgyur phyag rgya dgos pa sogs// lam 'bras rang gzhung dgongs pa ste// de yis gdul byar de dgos pa// yin gyi kun la rgyas ma 'gebs// las kyi phyag rgya yongs dor zhing*// ye shes phyag rgya rnam par spangs// phyag rgya che las yang dag skyes// lhan skyes gzhan dang 'grogs pas min// zhes gsungs pa yang gang zag gi /rim pa rjes su dpag pa ste// des na dbang po'i bye brag dang*// sbyor shes mkhas pas gzhan blun po// rgyud dang tshad ldan gzhung mang por// rgyas bsdus go rim mang gsungs kyi// lam 'gros gcig gis kun bkri ba'i// gti thug khrigs la skyangs ma gsol// sa skya pa yi bsam gtan gyi// dbus su mthong ba'i bsam gtan par// tshig rtsa mi zin byin rlabs rgyu mtshan// gsar du zhugs pa'i sngar nas yod// phyag rgya bzhi yi ngos 'dzin dang*// go rim rgyu 'bras ming sna tshogs// yod par khas blangs bzhin du 'dir// gcig bden gcig rdzun su zhig smra// 'on kyang rab dbye drangs pa dang*// grub sder drangs pa'i phyag rgya bzhi// don dang go rim ma mthun par// rtsod par yin gyis gan mdzod du// drangs pa de ka klu sgrub rjes// yin rgyu'i khul gyis bsgrigs na yang*// ma 'grigs pa yi zol sbyor du// mar re mur re'i nyung mar mur// man snyer bkag pa'i phyag rgya bzhi// tshig bcad yin par gang gis 'grub// rab dbyer drangs dang ma mthun phyir// /smra ba mkhas pa'i bla col lags// mar pa lo tsās tshur mthong ngor// las kyi phyag rgya sbyor tshul bsten// dag pa'i snang ngor ye shes lha// bdag med ma dang lhag ger 'khyud// nas zad pa na phur ma bzhin// ci byung smra ba'ang bden mod kyi// khyed thugs rnal du phob cig ces// gsol ba 'debs pa'i dus la bab// rgyud sde 'og mar phyag rgya che// med pa'i rtags su mnyam sbyor gyi// 'grel pa drangs la rgya chen po skad pa de// ting 'dzin rgyal po'i don yin zhes// pu to ba yis gsung drangs pas// 'thad par smras dang dngos su 'gal// dpal ldan ye shes grags pas kyang*// phar phyin gyis 'dul dbang rnon dang*// 'bring rtul so so'i phyag rgya che// rgol pa'i lam rim bshad dang 'gal// gang gā ma las sngags kyis kyang*// phyag chen mthong mi 'gyur zhes gsungs// gsang sngags bla med sngags min nam// yin na rang tshig dngos su 'gal// rdzob rtags de kun rtog ge pas// gzigs rgya che mdog ngom phyir du// snying po'i gtam mang drangs pas lan// byis pas dar ma'i las ma mdzad// ma hā mu dra bsgrub pa'i byings// gang la rkyen de byin nas de// rnam 'gyur ci 'dras bsgrubs sogs kyi// nges tshig yang dag mi mkhyen kyang*// gti thug khrigs kyi dpe 'ga' las// sku mched brgyad pas bshus pa'i tshig /skam po kha cig gtan tshigs su// khyer ba de 'dras gar mi phyin// mu dra phyag dang rgya so sor// phral ba nor na rdo rje 'chang*// nor bar snang bas de khog la// 'dod pa'i dbang phyug grub mtha' tshugs// ji ltar bzhed na rdo rje'i tshig /phyag ni stong pa'i ye shes de// ngos zin rgya ni 'khor ba yi// mdud las grol zhes gsungs phyir ro// dper na buddha sangs pa dang*// rgyas pa gnyis ka la 'jug ste// ma rig gnyid las sangs phyir dang*// shes byar blo rgyas zhes bshad mtshungs// gcig tu bsdam na phyag gam rgya// mi 'da' ba yi don yin mod// rgyas 'debs de 'dra shor sa bzhi'i// gya ba yin pas 'dir mi mkho// phyag rgya phral ba bod rgan gyis// bcug pa'i rgyu mtshan yang dag ci// rang gi 'dod dang ma mthun pa// thams cad bod kyi bcug lags sam// sangs rgyas phral ba'i bshad pa'ang*// bod kyi bcug gam rgyu mtshan mtshungs// dkar brgyud 'gog pa'i lam zhor la// zla ba grags pa'ang 'gog gam ci// phyag bris mi mkhyen tshul bstan kyang*// ljags klog dag po mkhyen mno mod// rtog dang rtogs pa mi phyed /mi la ras pa'i tshad ma'i dpe// mkhan chen gsar par bkab cing khebs// de la khyed cag ma dgyes pa// gnong can sgyur 'gros yin lags grang*// sa skya'i ma hā paṇḍi tas// rig gnas mi mkhyen zer mkhan zhig /srid na de la gtam de smros// dpral me rkub kyis blangs kyang ci// phyag rgya'i go rim rgyud sde las// ji snyed gsungs phyir rtsod mi dgos// 'on te nā ro mai tri yi// gzhung dang mi mthun gral bsgrigs nas// de pa'i gsung ltar bcos pa la// brtsad phyir 'gal ba med kyang de// 'gal bar gzigs pa log shes yin// de tsam spangs ba'i mthu med dam// rnam kun mchog ldan stong gzugs la// byed pa rgyud 'grel du mar bshad// de dang tshul 'di mi 'gal kyang*// mi shes snang ngor 'gal ba'ang bden// lung rigs rtse mo brgya pa'i mtshon// phyar bas lcags kyi 'khor lo'i dbal// chag pa'i sgras kyang klad 'gems pa'i// sbyin skyes bu rnams snying re rje// zhes bya ba ni pha lam rdo rje'i mtshon cha las phyag rgya'i go rim sogs la dpyad pa'i sarga ste drug pa'o/// / zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po de// mngon sum sus rtogs de 'phags pa// stong gzugs sogs la phyag chen du// btags pa'i skabs dang 'di mi gcig /phyag chen sgom gyi bzang shos ni// ro gcig dang ni sgom med yin// de ldan gang zag so skye zhig /'dug na ltas ngan yin pas brdung*// don gyi phyag chen ye shes de// 'dus byas yin pa'ang dgra la zlog /'dus byas 'dus ma byas sogs kyi// khas len thams cad 'di ru zhig /bla med dbang bzhi dang 'brel ba'i// don gyi ye shes phyag rgya che// mtshan nyid pa ste gnas lugs phyir// lhag ma de min phyir btags pa// ba lang gis zil mnan phyir khyed// ba lang las kyang ngan nam ci// yang na ba lang 'tsho phyir khyed// lce spyang sprul pa yin lags grang*// bskyed rim las rgya'i phyag chen sogs// shes bya yin phyir dwags rgyud la// los grags 'on kyang dus gsum gyi// sangs rgyas bgrod cig lam zhes pa'i// rnam dpyad smras la mi rtogs pa// sgom chen smod pas brel tam ci// zung 'jug phyag chen rtogs rnal 'byor// skyes 'phags su yin brjod zin to// ming la dngos ming btags ming zhes// shing rta'i srol 'byed gong mas btags// des kyang khyed kyi spyan zur la// sgom chen pas bzhin gnod gyur tam// mchu nad can gyi glang po'i mtshul// lag pa'i bya byed mi nus kyang*// lag ldan glang po'i ming yin phyir// de la der 'bod 'gog nus sam// sna nyag gtum pa'i mi 'ga' la// seng ger btags la 'dra 'brel sogs// rgyu mtshan yod dang cig shos la// med sogs dngos btags 'byed shes mkhas// rgyu mtshan bshad du yod dang med// ji ltar na yang ming de des// tha snyad dus su dngos po de// 'khrul med go phyir btags par mtshungs// de phyir rnam dbye brjod 'di la// tshig dang don skyon med na yang*// 'brog rtags gtam dpes 'brog pa'i thugs// dkrugs pa'i zug rngu da gdod langs// lho ru bsdad pas byang rtags sangs// rnam par dpyod pas blun rtags grol// bod du skyes pas 'brog rul gyis// rdzob rtags de 'dra ston mi shes// rdzogs sangs rgyas las lhag pa'i dngos// med mod bstod phyir nyi zla ri// seng ge glang sogs de der mtshan// btags pa 'dra 'brel dbang gis yin// gzhan dang mi 'dre'i ched kyis gzhan// phal pa'i gnas skabs dag la bsam// gang du btags kyang sangs rgyas kyis// chos 'khor bskor la su zhig rtsod// phyag chen gnas lugs tshul bzhin du// brjod mkhan med pa nges par bden// bsam brjod yul las ring 'das de'i// ngang tshul su yis brjod par spobs// bstan pa'i snying po phyag chen de'i// rang gi ngo bo dbyer med de// 'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid gsungs// rtogs bya rtogs byed rtogs zin la// ltos nas gzhi lam 'bras phye ste// khams ni gnas skabs gsum dag tu// ming gsum gyis ni bstan zhes gsungs// dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs par// rgyud 'di bstan par mi bya'o// zhes pas bcos pa'i dkyil 'khor du// nges par 'jug dgos bstan na kwa'i// dkyil 'khor gzhan du zhugs pa la'ang*// rgyud 'di bstan par mi bya zhes// gsungs 'dis bcos ma'i dkyil 'khor du// sngar zhugs bkag ces smras na ci// skal ldan 'ga' la tshegs chung ngus// sgrib bzhi gtor nus bzhi blugs pa// lhan skyes rang zhal mngon gyur las// lhag pa'i smin byed dbang ga re// de 'dra dbang du bzhag nas der// dbang bskur de med dngos grub med// ces gsungs legs par bshad pa ste// de la gzu bo'i klan ka bral// mtha' gnyis sel dang nag po pa'i// lung sogs drangs phal sngags la dbang*// dgos pa'i shes byed kho na ste// grub zin sgrub pa'i ngal bas ci// de nas rnal 'byor mas zhus pa// phyag rgya chen po ji lta bu// kun rdzob rnam pa'i gzugs kyis ni// bde ba sbyin pa bshad du gsol// bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa// shin tu ring min thung ba'ang min// sogs kyi las rgya'i mtshan nyid bshad// dbang gis 'phros gleng 'di la med// gzhung 'di brtag pa phyi ma yi// le'u brgyad pa'i dbu na yod// gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// sogs ni dang po'i brgyad pa'i tshig

/yin phyir gzhung tshogs snga phyi 'khrugs// dri ba dri lan tshig don 'dzol// gnyis kas don 'di'i phyogs ma phyin// rgyud 'chad mi mkhyen mtshon dper bstan// mi yong bzhin du yong 'jug gis// sprang mo'i dor 'jol sa la drud// sngo phye 'thu ba'i zol 'gros kyis// phyogs 'dir smra ba nyung na mdzes// rgyud kyi rgyal po gzhan dang ni// bstan bcos chen po gzhan las kyang*// dbang bskur ba dang ma 'brel ba// de la phyag rgya chen po bkag /ces pa'i lung don bsgrub phyir du// klu sgrub rgya mtshos 'bad nas lung*// mang du drangs shing ltar snang gi /rigs pa bkod kyang thog ma khel// de la dpal ldan sa skya pa'i// bstan 'dzin gtso bo thub bstan rje// bya gshongs g.yog tu bab pa des// lan mang glengs kyang sngar bzhin brdug /grub zin bsgrub dang dgos med 'ga'// yang yang bsgrub pas mkhan chen gnyis// bsnyel bar gyur tam gzhung gi don// tshul bzhin da dung 'grub ma 'gyur// ye shes snying po rgyud rnam dag /min zhes su yi ngag las gsan// rgyud bdun nang tshan phyi'i phyi ma// 'di dang mtshan mthun rgyud gzhan lags// mdor bsdus pa ni 'dir zhes pa'i// mdor bsdus phyag chen thig ler te// de las skabs 'di'i ye shes snying*// bsdus pa dngos su gsal la gzigs// bsdus la rgyas dang rgyas la bsdus// yin la min dang min la yin// zhes sogs mkhas pa'i zhal sgo las// rgyu na blun pos ci zhig smra// pha rol phyin dang gsang ba sngags// rtogs bya'i lta dang thob bya'i 'bras// don gcig na yang khyad par bzhis// gsang sngags 'phags par bshad de'i phyir// phar phyin rang las dus ring por// dka' ba spyad mthar rdzogs sangs rgyas// gzhan dring mi 'jog thob pa ni// tshul sgron rab dbye'i gzhung gis grub// go ma chod kyi gzhi phyag chen// bla chen 'phags pas gsungs de'ang*// go ma chod du mi 'gyur ram// go chod smra ba gzhan su mchis// bcu gcig kun tu 'od kyi sa// 'pho ba'i bag chags ma spangs shing*// bsam gyis mi khyab gnas ma thob// gsung ba'i don rtsa cung ma dgongs// kun tu 'od sar bag chags dri// yod smra 'chal ba'i gtam ngan pa// blun sgom rnams kyi mgrin pa las// 'bab par rigs mod mkhas la min// 'pho ba'i bag chags dri ma der// yod na sangs rgyas sgra don nyams// bsam mi khyab gnas ma thob pa// dngos su kha sbyor med la dgongs// pha rol phyin las sa bcu gcig

/sngags las bcu gsum bshad pa dang*// gung mthun bsgrigs shes mkhas pa ste// bstan pa 'gal med 'char phyir ro// tshogs kyi sa dang mos spyod pa// dang po gnyis pa'i sar bgrangs nas// brtsis pa'i kun tu 'od bcu gsum// rdo rje'i sa zhes man snyer bshad// yang na khyad pa lam dpe med// bar chad med lam ye shes ldan// sngon btang kun tu 'od dngos gzhi// bcu gsum par yang man snyer bshad// de lta'i bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin// mthar thug bod kyi gsang 'dus sogs// min par bsgrub pa'i rgol ba de// ma traṃ ru tras sprul tam ci// bskyed rim dang ni las rab 'byams// mi gcig pas ka bskyed rim mam// zhes pa tshig gis rnam dpyad smos// rdzogs rim sogs la'ang rigs pas bsgre// la la'i snang ngor ci yang 'char// la lar phyogs 'dzin kho na las// gzhan mi 'char ba'i snang cha de// rigs grwar phebs pa'i 'bras rtags red// bde mchog la brten sangs rgyas de// gzhan min bdag ni ga la 'dod// de la rdo rje phag mo'i skyon// gtong mkhan smyon pa'i pha spun yin// phyogs snga'i 'dod la ma brtags par// ci byung yi ger 'brir 'jug pa// snag shog gron la mi brtsi yang*// mkhas pa'i srid la mi gnod dam// chos rnams thams cad rang bzhin gcig /mos ngor sna tshogs gar du 'char// thams cad chos sku'i rgyal khams su// shes pas gang ltar byas kyang bde// zhes bya ba ni pha lam rdo rje'i mtshon cha las phyag chen rtogs tshul sogs la dpyad pa'i sarga ste bdun pa'o/// / rtog pa kha tshom zhes sogs don// rnam par dpyad pa'i tshig 'di dag /spang bya spong byed 'dod pa'i phyogs// drang don ltar na don la zhugs// nges don zab mo'i snying thig la// sbyangs gzhi gang zhig sbyong byed gang*// sbyongs 'bras gang zhes sor rtog gis// nang du dpyad na dmigs su med// yang dgon pa de chos rje yi// dngos slob gang zag bzang yang des// chos rje'i dgongs pa ma lon na// chos rje'i grub mtha' ji ltar 'dzin// mkhas grub yongs grags yang dgon pas// sa paṇa dgongs pa ma lon zhing*// nyid kyis lon zhes zhal 'ches pa// mngon pa'i nga rgyal ma ches sam// mtho dma' gar yang spang gnyen gnyis// yod pa'i drang don lung rig ka

/'dren la dgyes pa'i bshes gnyen gyis// thugs su nges don ci ste shong*// 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// bzhag par bya ba cung zad med// zhes sogs nges don gnad kyi dbyangs// rtog ge'i rna bar 'ud po che// deng sang sngags par rloms pa 'gas// gsang sngags bab col spyod pa dang*// mkhas par snyem 'gas nges don gyi// srog rtsa gcod la ngan 'gran byas// gti mug ces pa 'khrul pa'i blo// don la med pas brtags mi bzod// gti mug ltar snang de ka'i gshis// me long ye shes rnam snang mdzad// rgyas 'grel dri ma med pa'i 'od// theg pa kun don gsal byed yin// de phyir de yi brjod bya'i don// nyi tsher bkral na blun rtags ston// dus 'khor las bshad phyag rgya che// rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa'i gzugs// rgyal mchog skyed ma'i sgyu ma'i 'phrul// de nyid yin pa 'grel chen las// phra rab rdul gyi chos nyid 'das// pra phab pa yi rang bzhin can// rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i// phyag rgya chen po de la 'dud// zhes gsungs de ni sor sdud tshe// sha mig gis mthong bsam gtan tshe// brtan por gyur pa'i yon tan la// mngon shes lnga sogs 'byung ba'i don// des na mi 'gal ba la yang*// 'gal zhes brjod pa'i phra ma des// nges don srog la brgal mthar yang*// drang don rkang nas 'dren nam ci// rgyu 'bras lhun grub la sogs pa'i// gtam gyi sman mar bcud bzang po// skal bzang thub pas lon mod kyi// lhas byin pho drod kyis mi 'ju// blun pos phyag rgya che sgom pa// sogs kyi thad du spyi bshad 'ga'// mdzad de legs par mthong mod kyi// 'on kyang rim 'jug spyir btang nyid// dpyad sgom 'jog sgom gnyis ka la// nges par thos bsam dpyad pa ni// sngon 'gror dgos na dpyad 'jog la// rnam dbye med par mi 'gyur ram// lhag mthong skye phyir sor rtog gis// nang lta'i dpyad pa nges par du// dpyad 'jog gnyis ka la dgos par// tshad ldan mang pos gsungs phyir mtshungs// rtog pa kha tshom zhi gnas dang*// stong pa thal byung lhag mthong sogs// phyag rgya chen por bzhed pa yi// dkar brgyud tshad ldan su yang med// rgyu tshogs de des dud 'gro sogs// 'grub pa srid kyang phyag chen gyis// lan pa min phyir rtsod pa'i 'ja'// dngos med nam mkha'i mthongs su yal// rnam rtog chos sku'i gtam chen po// mkha' 'gro'i brda' skad bzhin du zab// rtog ge'i snyan dang mi 'tsham pas// gzhan du bshad zin 'dir mi spro// nam zhig zab lam thugs nyams su// bstar las nyams myong 'khrungs pa'i tshe// gtam 'di nges pa'i shes pa mchog

/skye 'gyur de dus mchid gsol lo// 'di la bla chen ngag dbang pas// rnam rtog chos sku don thob la// 'thad pa'i sgrub byed bkod pa de// khams pa skad rgyu drang ba'i gtam// de dus 'brug pa'i rtogs ldan rnams// sangs 'phags byang 'phags gang yin zhes// khong rang tsho la dri mol mdzod// bdag ni 'chings ldan so skyes lags// gnas tshod rnam rtog chos skur gnas// de la bsam nas de skad smras// rtogs tshod rang gi mkhos dang sbyar// de la brnyas dor sdang mi rig /mkhas gang shes bya'i de kho na// ji bzhin rtogs par yin par 'dod// ces gsungs de ni bden pa ste// cig shos snying po med pa'i rdzun// dkar brgyud bla ma phal mo che// mkhas par sbyangs mthar grub brnyes pa// sha stag yin phyir deng sang gi /mkhas rloms dag gis bsgrun pa med// mar rngog mtshur mes sgam po pa// 'bri tshal gling gtsang o rgyan pa// rang byung rdo rje sogs mang pos// grub mtha'i rtsa ba legs btsugs pas// nyams med skyong phyir bstan 'dzin gyi// skyes chen slar byon rnams kyis kyang*// rnam par dpyod pa'i blo spel phyir// dgag sgrub mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bskor// dkar brgyud bzhed srol skyangs shing 'khyongs// de la rgol ba'i lta ngan gcod// sgrub pa'i srol bzang mi nub pa'i// rgyal mtshan mthon por bsgrengs la ltos// grags 'dod rlung lha'i phus btab 'gas// rgyal ba'i gan mdzod la 'gran phyir// gzhan tshig brkus zhor bsgyur bsres nas// byi ba'i nor bzhin lkog tu bsags// kun mkhyen chos kyi khrir 'dzegs nas// de lugs mi 'khyongs bzhin du yang*// gzhan gyi 'u lag rgyug pa des// brag dang mchod rten dpe don tshang*// drang nges gnyis su ma 'dus pa// med kyang gsum du phye ba'i lung*// drang don gnas skabs nges pa'i don// mthar thug nges don gsum mo zhes// sa skya'i bla chen gong mas gsungs// de yang tshad ldan min na subs// nyid kyis ma gzigs gzhung lugs dang*// bong bus ma thar lam 'phrang mang*// rdo rje rnam 'joms gzungs chen sogs// mdo sder btags kyang sngags gzhung ste// rgyud do cog gi rtsa ba zhes// gsungs pa khyed kyis ma gzigs sam// 'tshang rgya'i thabs la nges par du// tshigs gsum rim can dgos pa'ang min// dgos kyang sngags kyi dge bsnyen sogs// dus kyi 'khor lor gsungs pas tshang*// skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sa lam sogs// mdo las gsang sngags gsal rgyas te// skyabs kyi yul dang skyob pa'i don// sems bskyed cho ga bslab bya rgyas// 'dus pa rnam gsum tshogs kyi lam// chung 'bring chen por bshad pa sogs// mdo na mi gsal khyad par chos// mang po sngags la yod phyir rgyas// bcu gnyis pa nas bcu drug gi

/bar gyi sa lam rnam gzhag sogs// mdo las rgyas pa'i gtam mang po// rgyud sder bshad do blo ma chung*// rgyal po'i srid kyi dbang phyug la// mngon dbang bskur ba rgyal rigs kyi// bstan bcos las bshad de yang der// tshad ldan yin par dngos su grub// rgyal por dbang bskur 'tshang rgya'i thabs// yin par sgrub dka' 'grub kyang don// med do sngags kyi brjod bya mdor// don gyis tshang bas tshang go chod// mi gsal phyir dang ches gsal phyir// mdo tsam pa dang gya nom zhes// thub pa chen pos mdo rgyud las// gsungs des mdor bstan rgyas bshad grub// rang sa'i thad kyi brda' chad rnams// rang sar bden pa min na ni// 'jig rten lugs dang chos lugs kun// khyed kyis gzu lum ral gris brod// 'di thad log shes ldog pa'i ngag /ji snyed smra bar spobs na yang*// sbrul la 'o rgyun bzhin du khyed// khro bo'i dug rlangs khol ba'i rgyu// gzu bo'i thugs ldan mkhas pa 'gar// 'bel mchid gleng la dga' mod kyi// phyogs 'dzin gdon gyis rlom rnams la// mi smra'i brtul zhugs len par spro// skyes sbyangs mkhyen pa phyug khyed ni// drang gtam shing rtas bgrod rigs mod// 'khyog tshig chu shing 'khar ba la// brten pa'i dbul por dgyes sam ci// nyid dang 'dris pa'i rgyus ldan 'gas// mkhyen par bstod dang mdzad par smad// ci rig gleng yang da gdod 'dir// mnyam nyid klong du rgya yi thobs// zhes bya ba ni pha lam rdo rje'i mtshon cha las rnam rtog chos sku sogs la dpyad pa'i sarga ste brgyad pa'o/// / dgos med tshad ma'i bshad yig las// dgos ldan sgra yi bsgyur tshul rnams// gnas skabs 'di 'dra mkho mod kyang*// mi shes mdun du ci byar yod// sngon byon lo tsās bsgyur ba rnams// grul ma btub ches ngas ma smras// de skad khyed kyis smras pa yis// nyes pa bdag la dkri mi 'os// 'on kyang snga 'gyur go dka' zhing*// 'bru don gnyer la ma bde ba// mang zhig snang la 'jig rten mig

/phyi ma rnams kyis 'gyur bcos mdzad// khyad par chos rje'i mkhas 'jug tu// 'gyur rnying la lar bka' bkyon zhing*// slad kyi bsgyur tshul 'di dang 'di// 'dra ba dgos shes dper brjod bstan// snga mas 'thus na phyi mas ci// 'gyur bcos mdzad pa'i lo tsā bar// ri bong rwa 'khyogs gsum rtsegs kyis// skyon gtong phod pa'i snying khams mtshar// mgo bsgre'i lan la bsnyon dor gyi// rkun mas kha skyengs ma bzod par// 'chal tshig mtshon gyis mi gsod mkhan// kyi hud dus ngan ma mas bskrun// sgra yis rnam bzhag rtsa bzhin du// dor sogs zhang lor gdams zer yang*// de ni khyed dang khyed 'dra ba'i// gzu lum can la 'doms par nges// sems kyi rang bzhin 'khor gsum bral// de ni phyi nang gar mi gnas// mi shig thig ler rten bcas sems// lus la gnas shes rgyud sder gsungs// lus can rnams kyi lus de ko /lus can rnams kyi rgyud yin nam// mnyam par ma bzhag bzhin du gtam// smra ba grags pa min pa'i gtam// sems las gzhan pa'i chos med pas// las nyon phung skyes lta sgom sogs// thams cad sems gcig kho na'i 'phrul// yin phyir skyon gzhan 'dir mi 'jug /rang sems gdod nas rnam dag pa// brtan g.yo kun gyi khyab bdag ste// de nyid gzhi lam 'bras gar yang*// chos sku'i ngo bor 'gyur ba med// de bzhin dang po'i sangs rgyas las// chos longs sprul sku gsum dag tu// ngo bo rnam pa byed las kyis// sgo nas bzhag la skyon ci yod// de nyid chos sku ma yin pa'i// sgrub byed yang dag mkha'i padmo// gshis mdangs bde stong thabs shes sogs// gdod nas zung 'jug yin le red// rang bzhin gzhi la lhun grub ste// de la gnas 'gyur rtsi mi dgos// sku bzhi'i bzhag mtshams ches mang phyir// gcig la a 'thas mdzad mi 'tshal// sa bon gcig las sdong po gnyis// zhes pa dpe cha dag par 'gyur// rtsa ba zhes pa yi ge pas// nor zhes smras la skyon ci yod// yi ge ma dag rtsom pa po'i// skyon du 'dod na khyed kyi dper// ma dag brgyud mar bris 'di tsho// thugs skyon 'ba' zhig yin lags grang*// 'on te byams pa chos grags khong*// g.yas bskyis 'phrul nas bos pa ste// khros kyi dgos na ma dag skyon// nyid rang kho nas don lon mdzod// 'khor 'das thams cad rang sems su// blo thag chod pa'i chig thub la// skyon gtong ji tsam mdzad kyang de// byi la'i mjug ma'i lhan tshal 'dra// des na dkar po chig thub la// brten pa'i lab lob lbu phreng rnams// tshigs bcad 'o ma'i rgya mtsho 'dir// nyer zhi mngar ba'i bcud du 'khyil// brgal rtags sgog rdog re re'i mgor// lan bzang tshwa rdog 'jog shes kyang*// 'chi chos sgrub dang dad 'dus la// chos 'doms brel phyir bsdus tsam bkod// mtshan nyid mkhyen pa'i khur chen pos// phrag pa mnan kyang nges don gyi// tshig don sha chod rus chod du// ma song sha mkhregs rus mkhregs gyur// nged kyis byis pa gzhon nu nas// sde snod 'ga' la sbyangs shing bsgoms// mi shes mun pa 'thug po de// cung zad srab pa'i nges pa thob// thub bstan chos grwa ma 'grims phyir// sde snod mi shes gsungs na ni// sa paṇa la sogs mkhas pa phal// de 'dra lags pas thal ches sam// gsang sngags sde snod ma yin na// 'dul ba mdo sde mngon pa dang*// gcig ni sngags kyi sde snod yin// gsungs pa de yang khyed kyis subs// sngags pa yon tan chen pos kyang*// 'bel gtam rtsod grwar zhugs tshe brdugs// zer ba de ni e waṃ pa// dpon slob mang por 'khu bar zad// chos 'byung rnam pa tshul bzhin du// rtsom mkhas de ni chos rgyus can// tshigs sbyor shes pa kho nas te// gzhan gyis ba lang brtul zhugs ngom// nyams 'gyur can gyi tshigs bcad dang*// lhug pa rtsom shes snyan ngag mkhan// de bzhin nges par mkhas pa ste// de yis rgyu gsum tshang phyir de// rang bzhin gyis grub spobs pa dang*// mang du thos par dri med dang*// mngon par sbyor ba mi dman pa// snyan dngags phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu// zhes gsungs yon tan mtshor 'khyil kyang*// tshigs bcad zur dod legs pa tsam// rtsom mi shes pa yod na de// mkhas par bstod kyang blun po yin// dper na me phung che 'bar kyang*// tsha ba'i reg bya med do zhes// brjod dang khyad med de 'dra'i mtshor// ru sbal de las byung dogs med// thams cad mi mkhyen pa la'ang ming*// thams cad mkhyen par bos so lo// 'o na khyed kyis lung khungs kyis// thams cad mkhyen pa'ang de 'dra'am// zla ba'i gzugs brnyan chu snod du// shar la zla shar sgras bsnyad kyis// 'brel med rtsod tshig de 'dra yis// mkhas pa'i gzi brjid skyel bas spangs// gzugs zla bse ru gcig ming du// bzhag nas zla ba'i sku sogs gsungs// rgyud kyi rgyal por tho 'tshams pa'i// rgol ba de lta su yis bskrun// zla gnyis phan chad mthong log shes// yin zhes smras la skyon ci yod// zla ba bye ba phrag brgya sogs// khyed kyi spyan des gzigs sam mtshar// yan lag ldan gzhi yan lag can// ldan rgyu yan lag nying lag yin// yul der dbang po tshang ba las// zha long 'theng gsum bzang ba mtshar// ka mā las bzhin deng sang gi

/hwa shang lung rigs bzang pos thul// sdang smras lkog tu mdzad pa'ang thad// de bas dngos su khu tshur bsnun// lo rgyus ming 'dogs go rim la// sngar byon mkhas pas ma dpyad lo// hwa shang lo rgyus rtogs ldan ming*// rnal 'byor bzhi yi go rim la// dpyad pa mdzad pa'i chos rje sogs// sngar byon min nam mkhas pa min// mkhos med sbrang bu'i gshog brgyangs kyis// nyi zla sgrib 'dod khyed kyi lugs// rgya nag lugs kyi phyag chen gzhung*// rkun nor yin pa'i dpe zla la// gnyen po gsang ba bkod snang ba// de yang rkun nor lags sam mtshungs// spangs rtogs yon tan cher med kyang*// thabs tshul du mas 'du 'dzi la// skyug mer langs nas spangs pa bdag /'jig rten srid pa ches so lo// bsgrub bya'i snying po de dang de// thugs la brnag pa mtshon pa'i dpe// ston mkhan srid pa chung ngam min// chos spyan ldan pas dpang mdzod cig /'di skor ngam ring mkhan chen par// phul ba des go chod pas slar// skyor zlos mi bya yig tshogs kyis// sun pas de tsam zhig tu bsdus// phyag chen ngo bo spros pa bral// de mngon gyur la chig chod zer// sa lam mang por spros pa'i dod// spros nyung rnal 'byor bzhi ru brtsams// shes phyin lta ba gsang sngags ba'i// thabs kyis zin na grol bar myur// de yang bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis// dbang bzhi gcig car thob pa yin// yul dang yul can sogs gnyis chos// dbu ma'i lta bar bzhag de kas// byis pas dar ma'i bya bzhag la// 'jug mi rigs zhes gsol lags mod// zhib mor bsnyad blo'i tshig rdzun rnams// ji tsam phyar kyang don gyi 'bras// ma mthong de phyir lta grub kyi// gnad zab da dung ma dgongs gda'// stong nyid snying rje sogs bsgoms pa// la sogs gzhung tshig khog can 'di'i// don zab mkhas su re bas kyang*// ma go yus kyis brnangs kyang ci// de yis 'gal 'dzin log rtog sprin// dengs par ma nus ston ka'i rdzi// kha bar babs pa'i 'tshubs 'gyur bzhin// gzhung don nyi zla slad kyis bsgribs// bya gshong g.yog gi gla dus de// khyer na gzhung 'di'i dgongs pa tshol// gal te min na sdang smras kyi// bla col gsung las 'os ci mchis// 'khor lo bar pa ngo bo nyid// med la rang bzhin gyis yod par// khas len nged kyi byas so snyam// mnal lam 'khrul pa'i bla col mdzad// bar mar ngo bo nyid med kyang*// bdag med tsam zhig khas blangs te// bdag yod ces kyang bstan 'gyur zhes// gsungs de cung zad dpyad pa'i gtam// tha mar shin tu dpyad rdzogs pas// bdag dang bdag med sogs gar yang*// khas len med cing 'khor gsum bral// de ni legs phye mtshan don ldan// de phyir phyi ma nges don la// ltos nas snga ma drang don te// phyi ma'i rigs pas snga ma rnams// sun 'byin nus pa blo khyad yin// de la klan ka'i skyugs lhad las// blo ma tshad kyi chu 'dzag pa// smra po mkhas kyang phyugs nyid du// mtshon pa'i brda thabs yin la rag

/ting 'dzin mchog 'di sgom byed dang*// dran dang ldan zhing blo gros ldan// ye shes 'phags pa thos pa 'dzin// spobs pa rgya cher 'gyur zhes dang*// dran dang blo gros rtogs ldan zhes// ming du ma zad mtshan nyid kyang*// rgyas par bshad la mngon sum du// bsnyon pa'i spyi brtol de 'dra ang*// sa skya dang ni sa skya'i dgon// blun zhes sus zer sa skya yi// mtshan nyid mdo dang rgyud sde las// ma bshad pa dang stobs mtshungs sbyar// da lta'i dus kyi rtogs ldan 'ga'i// kun tu spyod pa'i ngang tshul la// khrel ba'i nyams 'gyur ston pa mad// 'di na'ang de ka sems shing mchis// lod 'ga'i rtags kyis rtogs ldan kun// ngan par bsgrub par mi rigs te// sgrub pa'i go chas sgrub brgyud kyi// bka' srol skyong ba'ang mang mchis phyir// bslab pa 'chal yang bstan bshig phyir// rab byung chas kyis bu byung 'byung bar 'gyur zhes bshad// de dag thabs kyis 'dul ba'am// rtsod pas tshar gcod nus na legs// gzhan du kun slong ngan pa'i gdon// thugs la zhugs zhes 'phyas 'dogs 'gyur// grub thob dang ni rtogs ldan la// chung 'bring chen po so sor yod// grub thob las ni rtogs ldan lhag /ces pa'i ku re theg dgos so// 'khrul zhig rtogs ldan dgongs bzhed la// med kyang re zhig phan gnod med// khams ro gyong po'i 'dun sa der// mgul la gzab bya mdzad pa zab// thun mong dngos grub thob pa'am// de sgrub pa la grub thob sgra// 'jug ste bum dbang tsam thob la'ang*// dbang thob sgra don tshang dang mtshungs// las bzhi grub brgyad sangs rgyas pa// grub thob chung 'bring cher gsal bshad// rang 'dod zhal du 'tshangs pa'i gtam// khyod kyis phrogs nas ngas ma thob// bon dang mu stegs byed sogs kyis// thun mong dngos grub thob na de// grub thob yin pa lhun grub pa// de phyir mi mthun ga la yod// lhun gyis ma grub pa de nyid// grub thob yin zhes smra rung na// lhun gyis grub de grub min du// bzhed pa lags sam a ye mtshar// dbang bzhi dang ni rim pa gnyis// rnal 'byor chen po'i khyad chos yin// gsungs pa 'gog phyir khyed kyis 'dir// rnal 'byor rgyud la dbang bzhi bshad// de 'dra'i zhal gyi padma de// zla zer skud pas bcings nas slar// ba mo'i la rgyas 'debs shes na// thub bstan rnam rgyal la mdzes so// zhes bya ba ni pha lam rdo rje'i mtshon cha las sgra skad bsgyur tshul sogs las 'phros pa'i sarga ste dgu pa'o/// /

ma go ba yis bsgoms tsa na// gol shor 'ong ba bden mod kyi// phyin ci log tu go ba tsam// snying por mdzad khyed slar gson zhig /thog mar go bas mtha' dpyad de// nyams su myong bas rgyud la 'byor// de nyid rnal 'byor mngon sum du// gyur la go nyams rtogs pa gsum// thun mong skyes 'phags gnyis ka yi// rgyud la yod pa'i nyams myong yin// thun mong ma yin 'phags kho na'i// mngon rtogs yin mod klan ka sam// de yang gsal ba gser ldings pa'i// dkar khrid nag khrid sogs las byung*// nyams kyi 'od gsal sgyu lus te// kun rdzob bden yang dag bya yin// rtogs pa'i 'od gsal mngon byang ste// don dam bden pa dag 'bras yin// zhib rtsing ji ltar yin kyang 'dra// grub pa brgyad po'i snying gtam rnams// rtog ge'i spyod yul min pas na// dpe sna gzigs kyang cung ma dgongs// 'dir bstan go nyams rtogs pa zhes// bshad pa'i don ni de legs mod// spyir btang go rtogs don gcig tu// 'dod pa kun tu ga la 'gog /rnal 'byor bzhi po rje mar pa'i// slob ma rnams la med do lo// 'o na mi la'i mgur 'bum du// rnal 'byor bzhi mgur gsungs de ci// 'on te gsal rgyas srol gtod mkhan// dwags po khu dbon slob bcas te// don la rton pa'i 'chad tshul gyis// nyams rtogs lung dang sbyar nas gsungs// gzhon nu don grub sprul pa'i sku// rang rgyud ji ltar bzhed kyang de'i// rmi ltas bzang bar 'dul mdo las// mngon sum bshad pa 'gog mi nus// lam 'bras lung dang sbyar ba dang*// rnal 'byor bzhi yi lung sbyor gnyis// blo tshad ngo na rigs shing mtshungs// blo ma tshad la su yid brton// sgom las 'phros pa'i dogs dpyad rnams// ye nas ma go'i rnam 'gyur dang*// go yang phyogs su lhung min kyang*// kun rmongs 'ga' la phan phyir brtsams// chos rnams rang bzhin med pa ni// yongs su shes par 'gyur zhes lung*// drangs nas rang bzhin yongs shes pa// 'gog na yang ni sdud pa las// shes rab kyis ni chos rnams kyi// rang bzhin yongs su shes nas ni// khams gsum las ni 'da' zhes gsungs// lung de gnyis la 'dam kha med// ma mthong pa nyid de mthong bar// shin tu zab pa'i mdor gsungs bzhin// rang bzhin med par yongs shes pa// rang bzhin yongs shes nyid du 'dod// de ni theg chen lam kun gyi// snying po lags mod de rtogs thabs// phyag chen las lhag gzhan med phyir// khyad chos chen por lhun gyis grub// dbang zhes bya ba dbang rdzas rnams// gtod len la sogs spros pa can// kho nar zhen pa'i a 'thas kyis// mkhas pa mang po dbu 'khor mangs// sngags kyi gdul bya spros pa yis// 'dul la de bzhin dgos na yang*// 'bring dang nyung ngus 'dul dgos rnams// de des 'dul shes mkhas pa yin// de lta ma yin rnam kun tu// dbang bskur bya bas bkris dgos na// bya bas grol ba thob pa min// bya ba yin phyir zhing las bzhin// zhes gsungs pa la ji skad smre// dbang don gar song cha med par// dbang chog bskyar bas ga la phan// dbang gi gzugs brnyan des ci bya// sems kyi gnas lugs mthong ba tsam// dbang thob pa min de 'dra'i srol// 'phags pa'i yul du ma byung zhing*// tilli nā ros ma gsungs lo// ri khrod dbang phyug yum bcas kyis// brda thabs tsam la de thob pas// sa ha kā ra siddhi des// dbang thob mchog gi dngos po grub// tilli'i spyan sngar nā ro pas// dka' chen spyad pa'i nangs kyi mthar// 'di ni rang rig ye shes te// ces sogs gsungs pas grol ba thob// nā ros dpal mchog ḍombhi par// bdud rtsi rlabs pa'i thod chang tsam// bstabs pa 'thungs pas mchog thob sogs// lo rgyus tshad ldan ji snyed mchis// tillis dbang gi mdud grol du// bskur du rdul tsam med pa la// yengs su skad cig med pa'i dbang*// zhes sogs gsung gi gsang ba byon// mar pas bla ma so so la// dbang nod pa ni cis kyang bden// rdul tshon bris nas rdzas gtod len// mtha' gcig mdzad pa'i skad cha med// mar pa'i slob ma dra sgom la// dbang ma bskur kyang byin rlabs de'i// rnam smin lus nyid dwangs ma'i skur// gyur nas mkha' spyod du gshegs so// dus phyi'i sa dkar gnyis thad du// rang bzo yod na yod mnyam phyir// rang skyon rkun rdzas ltar sbas nas// gzhan la gshe ba sdig pa'i las// theg gsum las bshad bla ma ni// dam pa yod na nyan rung la// dbang bskur yod dam med na ni// dbang ma bskur la bla ma med// zhes sogs thad du ci ltar gsungs// tha mal shes pa lhug pa ru// 'jog shes de kas gol shor chod// gcod thabs rtsol ba gzhan mi dgos// phyag chen rtog dang mi rtog ces// dpyod pa tha snyad mkhan po'i lugs// chos sku khyab gdal zang yag mar// shes tshe de lta'i mdud las grol// rnam rtog rang bzhin shes tsa na// rnam rtog rang gis rang grol ba// de la rtog pa rang grol zer// spangs dang grol ba 'dir mi gcig

/lung 'dren gnyis don rtog med kyi// shes pas nyes pa spangs la dgongs// rtog pa med na mi spongs pa'i// gsungs dang re zhig 'gal gyi dogs// phyag rgya chen po'i sgom ngo ma// skyes la sbyor dngos rjes thams cad// mnyam nyid lags kyi sbyor rjes gnyis// rtog ces zur du 'jog mi dgos// phyag chen mngon sum rtogs pa'i rten// zhi gnas la'ang der 'dogs pa// sgra yangs pa yi dbang du byas// phyag chen ngo ma de ma yin// des na gzhi dus phyag rgya cher// bsam na ma gtogs phyag chen de// rgyud ldan so skye med pa'i tshul// gong du'ang zhus pa ma gsan tam// yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis sogs// ston par nus dang mi nus pa'i// rnam dbye khams pa drung nas la// zhus zin de la gzigs shig kye// khyed kyi chos las mthong lam tsam// thob pa'i nus pa'ang med lags sam// brgya phrag ston pa'i bshes gnyen ni// gnas der su byung su yis mthong*// mthong lam thob pa'i rmi ltas mkhan// chos rgyus chung ba yin na ko /sa skya'i lo tsā'ang der thal te// rmi lam nges bstan drangs phyir ro// chos rje'i drin las gangs can 'dir// bshad pa'i srol chen 'phel bden zhing*// mi la'i drin las sgrub pa'i srol// 'phel la'ang gzur gnas su zhig bsnyon// des na gcig bstod gcig smod pa// kun slong ngan pa'i gdon gyis sbyar// log rtog rmeg med bcom zin na// khyed kyis su la gang zhig smre// tsha ba'i reg byas ring btang ba'i// me des su yang mi bsreg zhing*// gnyis med seng ge'i sgra des kyang*// rgol ba'i glang chen spobs pa bsgrubs// bsdus brjod snyan tshig gzugs brnyan zhig /rtog pa'i me long ngos su shar// de la daṇḍi khrel ba'i dbyangs// dri za'i rgyud mangs sgra dang sbyar// longs med 'chi bas 'jigs nas 'dir// 'chi med gnyug mar gzhol ba bdag

/rtsom rtsod g.yengs bas sun na yang*// khyed ngor nyung zhig smras pa lags// tshig bongs bsdu phyir tshigs su bcad// don du 'khril phyir don rtsa bzung*// legs bshad goms phyir legs par gleng*// kun tu dgyes phyir kun bstod do// dpe sna bsags pa'i bzhin mtshar la// yun ring sred pa'i rtog dpyod mkhan// nyid kyi blo gros 'phel de yang*// kho bo'i legs byas kho nas bsgrubs// de sogs rnam dkar dge ba'i las// ji snyed dus gsum bsags pa'i mthu// ris med sems can ma lus pas// stobs bcu'i go 'phang thob phyir bsngo// de skad padma dkar po'i 'dab// rnam par grol ba'i sbrang rtsi'i rgyun// gzhibs pas rnam dpyod lang tsho'i dpal// nya rgyas zla ba'i rjes 'gro ba// buddha badzra zhes bya yis// rnam byung lha babs dus ston la// grub pa'i zhing khams dpal gyi rir// legs bris legs par bsrings 'di dge// /zhes bya ba ni pha lam rdo rje'i mtshon cha las go nyams rtogs pa sogs la dpyad pa'i sarga bcu pa ste phyogs dus kun las dza yantu//
